task_and_failure: The production local generation endpoint (Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_M on llama.cpp b11146, 36 of 65 layers on the GPU) decodes at a median 4.79 tokens/s (its own journal, 70 replies) under partial offload. Newer Qwen3.8-family serving profiles and releases from the past weeks may be faster at equal quality on the north-star 8-K item-extraction workload, but no frozen, paired comparison exists on this workstation.

baseline_and_candidate.baseline: C0: production Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_M, llama.cpp b11146, 36 GPU layers, 8192 context, frozen non-thinking greedy request.
baseline_and_candidate.candidate: C1 (same model, every layer and the output head on the GPU, dense FFN of blocks 0-19 on the CPU), C2 (C1 plus MTP drafting from the file's own MTP layer) and M (MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B Q8_0, all layers on the GPU), each scored on the same filings with the same request; B and X are predeclared runtime_unsupported.

predeclared_metrics.quality_rule: An arm replaces C0 as the production generation model only if (1) the paired bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 20260926) 95% lower bound of micro-F1(arm) - micro-F1(C0) is at least -0.02, (2) its median decode tokens/s exceeds C0's, (3) its JSON-valid rate is at least 0.98, and (4) it had no memory or deadline failure. Inference speed alone does not pass. C1 or C2 passing means keep the model and change only the serving profile. Micro-F1 is over per-accession item-code sets against the filer-declared header ITEMS; macro-F1, exact match and per-filing precision and recall are reported alongside.
predeclared_metrics.usage_rule: Retain llama-server usage (prompt and completion tokens) and timings per filing as local-model counters. No provider usage, cache categories or token-savings claim; unknown values stay null.

runtime_and_platform.isolation: One arm segment at a time on 127.0.0.1:18299 in its own systemd user scope (MemoryMax 20G, no swap, verified) with a 1 Hz whole-device GPU-memory guard whose queries are bounded; the production unit is stopped for the window, a transient restore timer is armed first, and the exit trap restores production with bounded steps. Filing text, raw replies, error bodies and server logs stay private; not an OS sandbox.

commands: uv run --no-project --with jsonschema --with pyyaml python -m unittest tests.test_local_inference_latest_20260926 -v
limitations: Preregistration only: no model download, inference or SEC request was made for this record.
Labels are filer-declared header ITEMS, not hand-checked or frontier-model labels; the task is a proxy for catalyst extraction and does not meet that catalog trial's gate.
One day of filings (at most 360 accessions from 2020-03-02); not a representative sample of 8-K forms or years.
Inputs are capped at 16,000 characters (head and tail); items in a dropped middle are unreachable for every arm alike.
C0 needs an expected two segments (windows) at the production profile; segments run at different times on a shared WSL2 desktop, so timing and memory are shared-host, whole-device observations.

Admission needs Windows-side GPU applications closed first (at most 3,829 MiB there for C0 and M, 3,062 for C1, 2,678 for C2); the Windows-side residual after closing them was not measured, so C1 or C2 may still be refused.
C1 and C2 differ from the tasked profiles (-ngl 99 without FFN offload; the MTP draft file), which cannot be admitted beside the embeddings service on this host; those profiles have no result.
Device-memory estimates are planning figures from the GGUF tensor table and a fixed overhead; the measured guard protects other GPU users.
B and X are excluded by pinned-runtime evidence, not by a load attempt; Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is excluded by size.
Greedy non-thinking decoding is a fixed protocol, not each publisher's recommended setting.

decision_and_scope.scope: Frozen paired comparison of C1, C2 and M against C0 for non-thinking 8-K item extraction on the 2020-03-02 cohort on nativestack-5975wx-20260925, in resumable segments of at most one 3-hour window each; B and X runtime_unsupported on b11146.

rollback: Nothing changes in production unless the frozen rule passes. A window only stops nativestack-generation.service; its exit trap starts it again and waits for /health 200, and a transient restore timer armed before the stop does the same if the script hangs or is killed. The unit file is untouched and no drop-in is written. If a later adoption adds a serving-profile or model drop-in, rollback removes that drop-in, runs systemctl --user daemon-reload, restarts nativestack-generation.service and checks /health 200, keeping the current model files for that purpose.
next_decision_changing_test: Run the acquisition once, then C0 windows until C0's segment chain completes and a window for C1, C2 and M, after the coordination line reads TRIALS DONE and Windows-side GPU applications are closed; apply analyze.py --state-dir. A passing C1 or C2 changes only the serving profile; a passing M replaces the model. B or X re-enter only under a new plan with a pinned runtime that supports them.
